text: Quota Pets（DSH Web 插件）：在 DeepSeek Harness 页面展示随当前会话模型切换的桌宠，并用动画状态和额度提示陪伴编码。客户端读取模型与运行状态，显示 GLM、MiniMax、Kimi、DeepSeek 或 MiMo 对应形象；服务端提供桌宠图片和运行结果。额度数据复用 dsh-quota-hub，用户可拖动桌宠、调整大小、预览形象或点击刷新额度。适合希望在编码时查看模型状态与套餐额度的用户。需要配套 quota-hub 提供额度数据，本插件自身不读取 API Key。

Quota Pets shows an animated pet for the active DSH model. Its mood reflects session activity, and quota status comes from dsh-quota-hub. Users can move or resize the pet and click to refresh quota data. The hub is needed for quota status; this plugin does not read API keys.
想在 DSH 页面上放一个会跟着当前模型变化的桌宠。
有没有办法在编码时顺手看到模型运行状态和额度压力？
Show me a small animated companion for whichever model my DSH session is using.
Quota Pets 的功能「模型桌宠与额度提示」：页面按当前会话所用模型显示对应宠物，并根据运行状态切换动画；额度信息从 quota-hub 读取并以提示状态呈现。点击宠物会立即刷新额度，拖动和右键菜单可调整位置、大小或临时预览形象。
Quota Pets 从同源路径 /dsh-quota-hub/status.json 读取配套 quota-hub 的额度快照；缺少该服务时额度提示不可用（见 lib/client.js:59-60,322-345）。
dsh-quota-pets 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 7 天；提交数 53；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

**Quota Pets** — a chibi desktop-pet companion for DeepSeek Harness, one mascot per LLM coding plan:

dsh-quota-pets README · dsh-quota-pets：| Pet | Provider | Theme color |
|---|---|---|
| 🦊 Broad-Eared Fox Girl | GLM (z.ai / bigmodel) | Purple `#8B7CF6` |
| 🎙️ Conch Reporter Girl | MiniMax | Pink `#FF7DA0` |
| 🎵 Star-Moon Flute Girl | Kimi (Moonshot) | Gold `#F5C445` |
| 🐋 Whale Girl | DeepSeek | Blue `#4D6BFE` |
| 🧡 Bunny-Hood Girl | Xiaomi MiMo | Orange `#FF6900` |

dsh-quota-pets README · dsh-quota-pets：All five mascots are fully animated (idle / working / done / error / sleeping,
WebP, ≤12 fps, tuned to fit tight byte budgets — see the asset
[contract](docs/pet-contract.md)).

Quota data is consumed entirely from
[dsh-quota-hub](https://github.com/DarkDarkdDarkWine/dsh-quota-hub)
(`/dsh-quota-hub/status.json`) — this plugin never touches your API keys.
Without quota-hub installed, the pet still runs (question-mark state).

dsh-quota-pets README · Behavior：**Follows the active model** — only one pet is visible at a time: the one
matching the model of the current session. Switching models fades the old
pet out and the new one in. A brand-new conversation shows no pet until the
first query fixes the model (nothing matches → nothing shown).

dsh-quota-pets README · Behavior：| State | Behavior |
|---|---|
| Idle | Gentle floating; click to hop + refresh now |
| Session running | Working pose (each pet's own: whale girl eating, fox girl flipping pages, reporter girl with her clapperboard, flute girl playing, bunny-hood girl with her plush) + glow ⚡ |
| Run finished | One-shot celebration (~3s) ✅, then back to idle |
| Run errored | Drooping pose, badge ❌ |
| Idle 10 min | Sleeping 💤 (whale curl, girl naps on her rabbit…) |

dsh-quota-pets README · Behavior：Quota pressure is rendered as an overlay (badge + bubble + filter), never as
art: hover for the worst window usage + reset countdown; ≥70% warn / ≥90%
critical coloring; no key or disabled provider → ghost mode; query failed →
question mark ❓ with the error in the bubble.

dsh-quota-pets README · Behavior：Right-click menu: temporary avatar preview / size (64/88/112px) / reset
position / developer state cycler. Position and size are shared across all
pets and remembered in localStorage. Full state machine and design reference
in [docs/pet-capabilities.md](docs/pet-capabilities.md) (Chinese).

dsh-quota-pets README · Custom avatars：Assets live in `assets/<petId>/<state>.webp` (animated) plus
`<state>-static.webp` or `.png` (static fallback for reduced-motion), plus
optional transition clips `<from>-to-<to>.webp` played once between states
(GLM opens its book, MiniMax picks up its board or sits down to sleep), hot-swapped
within seconds — naming rules in [assets/README.txt](assets/README.txt),
validation via `scripts/validate-assets.py`, full spec in the asset
[contract](docs/pet-contract.md).

dsh-quota-pets README · Install：```
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:DarkDarkdDarkWine/dsh-quota-pets
```

Pairs best with
[dsh-quota-hub](https://github.com/DarkDarkdDarkWine/dsh-quota-hub).

dsh-quota-pets README · dsh-quota-pets：五只全部为全帧动画（idle / working / done / error / sleeping，WebP、≤12fps、
按字节预算精调——素材规格见[资产合同](docs/pet-contract.md)）。

额度数据完全复用 [dsh-quota-hub](https://github.com/DarkDarkdDarkWine/dsh-quota-hub)
（`/dsh-quota-hub/status.json`），本插件不碰任何 API Key；没装 quota-hub 时
桌宠照常出现（问号态）。

dsh-quota-pets README · 行为：**显示规则：跟随当前模型** —— 同一时刻只显示当前会话正在用的模型那只，
切模型时旧宠淡出、新宠淡入。全新的空白对话先不显示宠物，发出第一条
消息、模型确定后才登场（检测不到就不出场）。

| 状态 | 表现 |
|---|---|
| 待机 | 轻盈浮动；点击跳一下并立即刷新 |
| 会话运行中 | 各自的干饭/干活姿势（鲸鱼娘干饭、阔耳狐娘翻书、记者娘打板、星月少女吹笛、兔耳帽少女抱兔）+ 金光晕 ⚡ |
| 一轮完成 | 一次性庆祝动作（约 3 秒）✅ 后回到待机 |
| 出错 | 垂头姿势 + 角标 ❌ |
| 挂机 10 分钟 | 睡觉 💤（鲸鱼蜷睡、少女枕兔…） |

额度压力只以角标/气泡/滤镜叠加呈现，不做成美术：悬停出气泡（最紧张
窗口 + 重置倒计时）；≥70% 警告色 / ≥90% 危险色；未配 Key 或停用 → 幽灵
半透明；查询失败 → 问号 ❓ 气泡显示原因。

dsh-quota-pets README · 行为：右键菜单：临时预览形象 / 大小（64/88/112px）/ 重置位置 / 开发者状态
循环。位置与大小全宠共享，记忆在 localStorage。完整状态机与设计对照表见
[docs/pet-capabilities.md](docs/pet-capabilities.md)。

dsh-quota-pets README · 自定义形象：素材放在 `assets/<petId>/<state>.webp`（动画）+ `<state>-static.webp` 或
`.png`（reduced-motion 静态兜底），另可放过渡片段 `<from>-to-<to>.webp`，
切换状态时先播一遍（GLM 翻开书、MiniMax 拿起记录板或坐下睡觉）；热加载秒级生效——命名规则见
[assets/README.txt](assets/README.txt)，校验脚本
`scripts/validate-assets.py`，完整规格见[资产合同](docs/pet-contract.md)。

dsh-quota-pets README · 安装：```
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:DarkDarkdDarkWine/dsh-quota-pets
```

与 dsh-quota-hub 配对使用效果最佳。
